Selepas pemergian Aini, sebuah rakaman video yang ditinggalkannya mendedahkan rahsia yang mengubah kehidupan Anggara buat selama-lamanya.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah mengenang saat dia kehilangan ibu dan bapanya, segala kenangan diimbas kembali dengan kesedihan yang tidak tertanggung. Kini, hidup Aisyah di penuhi dengan rasa sedih atas layanan dan sikap Mak Su Ainin dan dua orang sepupunya Fasha dan Farid. Aisyah melakukan semua pekerjaan di rumah selain mencari duit untuk diberikan kepada Mak Su Ainin sekeluarga. Sementara Fasha dan Farid hanya menanti Aisyah menandatangi surat penyerahan tanah kepada mereka yang dimiliki oleh arwah ibu dan bapa Aisyah. Semua ini atas arahan dan ajaran dari Mak Su Ainin. Iskandar lelaki yang hidup dengan kekayaan dan serba sempurna. Di kelilingi gadis-gadis cantik jelita persis model. Kehidupan dengan mengejar jawatan yang dijanjikan sebagai CEO di TG Holdings membuatkan Iskandar semakin hanyut melayari keseronokkan. Namun, cara hidup Iskandar tidak disenangi oleh Tengku Maria. Tengku Maria mula mencari jalan dengan menjodohkan Iskandar dengan Tengku Waiduri. Hal itu membuatkan Iskandar memberontak dan meminta Haziq membawanya bercuti.(n)

programme.desc: Aisyah melakukan kerjanya seperti biasa di dalam rumah yang tidak pernah memunculkan bahagia padanya. Farid memerhatikan bentuk tubuh Aisyah dan berniat mahu menganggu Aisyah. programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Haziq meluru keluar dari kereta apabila melihat Aisyah jatuh dan tangan Aisyah luka berdarah. Manakala Iskandar hanya duduk di dalam kereta dan tidak menghiraukan apa yang terjadi. Haziq menawarkan pada Aisyah untuk pergi ke klinik, belum sempat Aisyah bersetuju Iskandar sudah keluar dari kereta dan marah disebabkan menunggu. Aisyah terkejut dengan sikap Iskandar lalu menolak perlawaan Haziq. Kepulangan Aisyah di rumah dalam keadaan tangan yang luka membuatkan Fasha lebih suka mengenakan Aisyah. Dia meminta Aisyah melakukan segala kerja meskipun kerja itu sudah diselesaikan oleh Aisyah awal pagi lagi. Mak su Ainin akan sentiasa menjadi penyokong Fasha dalam membuli Aisyah. Ketika McCall menyesuaikan diri dengan kehidupan sebagai orang awam, dia terdorong untuk menggunakan sumber yang dimilikinya bagi membantu Jewel (Lorna Courtney), seorang remaja yang dituduh membunuh dan sedang diburu oleh penjenayah yang telah memerangkapnya atas jenayah tersebut.

Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.(n)

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP10
programme.desc: Memaparkan Cairyl dan Azhar menyembunyikan diri kerana takut ditangkap polis kerana merogol Lisa, Sara dan Afifah. Mbah Nira mengaku mahu membantu Afifah dan Lisa bagi membalas dendam mereka. Sebaliknya, tiba di rumah Mbah Nira membuat pengakuan kepada polis dia yang membunuh Pak Samad kerana dendamnya 7 tahun lalu, Mbah Nira ditahan polis. Syamil mendapat rakaman video menunjukkan kejadian Lisa dan Afifah di rogol oleh Kumpulan Hunter termasuk membunuh Sara. Afifah dan Lisa kemudiannya menggunakan kuasa ilmu hitam untuk menangkap Cairyl, Azhar dan Bakri. Afifah mahu membunuh kumpulan Hunter tersebut menggunakan ilmu sihirnya, namun Lisa tidak membenarkan. Tiba-tiba, Polis menyerbu dan menahan Lisa dan Afifah selepas mendapat maklumat dari Syamil. Kedua duanya di masukkan dalam penjara.(n)

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP5
programme.desc: Memaparkan Pak Samad menerjah Nasrun kerana menyebabkan cucunya di rogol oleh Kumpulan Hunter. Perbualan mereka didengari oleh Lisa tentang kejadian rogol ke ats mereka 7 tahun lalu. Lisa mendapat profil perogol mereka dari Syamil, mereka sedang mengumpul bukti dan mahu Pak Samad menjadi saksi. Caryl tidak percaya yang penyakit Bakri disebabkan sihir ilmu hitam, sebaliknya Nasrun dan Azhar membawa Mbah Nira untuk mengubatinya. Namun Mbah Nira gagal memulihkannya. Satu malam, Azhar ternampak lembaga Bakri membunuh diri, sebaliknya Caryl syak Bakri mengambil dadah. Lisa menyerahkan profil perogol mereka kepada Afifa setelah mendapat maklumat dari Bayu, jam dihadiahkan oleh perogol kepadanya 7 tahun lalu sama seperti yang diterima oleh Bayu.(n)

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP6
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Bayu memberitahu Lisa, doktor Caryl yang menghadiahkan jam tersebut kepadanya. Jenama yang sama pernah dihadiahkan oleh Caryl kepadanya. Perkara tersebut dikongsikan oleh Lisa dengan Afifa. Mbah Nira minta Bakri dibawa ke rumahnya untuk diubati. Lisa terdengar perbulan Caryl dengan Azhar semasa berada di klinik, nama Bakri dan Nasrun disebut sebagai ahli kumpulan mereka. Lisa dan Syamil telah mengenali setiap ahli Kumpulan Hunter, namun mereka perlu mendapatkan Pak Samad untuk dijadikan saksi sebelum bertindak membuat laporan polis. Walaupun Afifa mendesak supaya tindakan segera diambil. Manakala Nasrun menghubungi Syamil bagi membantunya. Syamil dan Lisa ke rumah Pak Samad, malangnya mereka mendapati Pak Samad telah mati membunuh diri.(n)

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP7
programme.desc: Memaparkan Syamil dan Lisa menghubungi polis selepas mereka menemui mayat Pak Samad semasa ke rumahnya. Syamil datang ke rumah Bakri selepas dihubungi oleh Nasrun bagi mengubati sakit Bakri, malangnya Azhar terlebih dahulu membawa Bakri ke rumah Mbah Nira untuk memulihkannya. Kesempatan itu digunakan oleh Afifa bagi menggunakan ilmu hitam secara dalaman ke atas Bakri, walaupun pada fizikalnya Bakri telah disembuhkan oleh Mbah Nira. Lisa marahkan Afifa kerana melepaskan Bakri dan Azhar balik kerana peluang yang ada tidak digunakan bagi mereka membalas dendam. Di rumah, Bakri sekali lagi di rasuk sehingga hampir membunuh Azhar. Nasrun terpaksa menghubungi Syamil untuk memulihkan Bakri dengan menggunakan pendekatan Islamik. Akibatnya, Afifa terkesan dan hampir mati.(n)

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP8
programme.desc: Imbas kembali beberapa tahun lalu semasa Lisa, Sara dan Afifa tinggal bersama Mbah Nira. Namun Sara mati, bagaimanapun Mbah Nira menggunakan ilmu hitamnya menjadikan Sara sebagai "Saka". Mbah Nira menurunkan ilmu hitamnya kepada Lisa dan Afifa. Kali ini, Cairyl dan Azhar bertindak menculik Afifa dan Lisa, mereka mendesak Lisa dan Afifa supaya mengarahkan Mbah Nira membebaskan Bakri daripada terus disihirkan. Tiba-tiba muncul “Saka” Sara menyebabkan Cairyl dan Azhar melarikan diri. Lisa dan Afifa balik ke rumah Mbah Nira, diketahui ilmu hitam yang dimiliki oleh Lisa lebih kuat berbanding Afifa. Bakri akhirnya meninggal. Nasrun merayu pertolongan Syamil, meminta Mbah Nira melepaskannya daripada disihirkan. Lisa bertindak menggunakan “Saka” Sara ke atas Azhar dan Cairyl.(n)

programme.title: The Equalizer S1 EP2
programme.desc: Iklan dalam talian McCall membawanya kepada seorang ibu yang anaknya telah diculik oleh seorang pemerdagang manusia (Thomas Beaudoin) dan akan dibunuh melainkan dia mencuri maklumat sulit daripada majikannya, seorang ejen FBI. Selain itu, McCall meminta bantuan Aunt Vi untuk membongkar rahsia yang sedang disembunyikan oleh Delilah daripada mereka berdua.(n)

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China

programme.title: Jerangkung Dalam Almari

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain (Haji Zul Ariffin), ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK) yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.(n)

programme.title: J Retribusi

Ketika Dato' Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.(n)

Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.(n)

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di sebuah banglo lama yang dikatakan penuh mistri terletak di Branang, Selangor. En. Solo Ambush seorang penjejak paranormal menemami perantara. Banglo ini pernah didiami oleh sebuah keluarga Cina, disebabkan berlaku beberapa kejadian misteri dan menakutkan, mereka berpindah keluar. Pengantara bersama Solo Ambush, berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. Namun tiada lembaga yang muncul. Solo Ambush berkongsi pengalaman semasa menjalankan siasatan di situ.(n)

programme.desc: Farhan bercadang untuk pulang dan bekerja di kampung, bapanya tidak bersetuju. Pada satu malam, Aishah mengigau berjalan masuk ke dalam rumah Wan Peah. Siti meminta bantuan 3 sahabat karibnya membawa Aishah balik ke rumah. Li berkejar ke rumah Tok Hashim meminta pertolongan. Sesampai Tok Hashim ke rumah Wan Peah, Siti berjaya mengeluarkan anaknya, Tok Hashim terus mencari Wan Peah. Tiba-tiba muncul Wan Peah di hadapannya. programme.desc: Detektif Khairul Malik menyimpan sebuah rahsia, yang teman wanitanya, Aisya tidak tahu mengenainya. Perkara menjadi rumit dengan penemuan mayat dua puluh tahun, yang menggerakkan rangkaian kejadian yang membawa maut. Kehidupannya berubah secara mendadak apabila dia bertemu Sofia, gadis yang berkebolehan meramal kematian orang. Apabila dia meramal sebuah tragedi dahsyat, Sofia mendapat perhatian polis dan juga seorang keturunan usahawan insurans ulung, Lokman Nazir. Tertarik dengan bakat unik Sofia, Malik meyakinkan dia untuk bekerja bersamanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa, tetapi niat baik mereka menyebabkan tragedi. Sementara itu, penghantaran sebuah pita menyebabkan huru-hara dalam hubungan Malik dan Aisya apabila rahsia gelap Aisya mula terungkai.(n)

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP9
programme.desc: Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton masih tidak berpuas hati dengan Cikgu Siti yang dikatakan memiliki ilmu hitam. Perkara ini dihebohkan menyebabkan orang kampung mulai menjauhkan diri dari Cikgu Siti. Farhan menegur perbuatan Cikgu Zaiton kerana membuat fitnah kepada Cikgu Siti. Farhan masih cuba berbaik-baik dengan Cikgu Siti, bagaimanapun Cikgu Siti cuba menjauhkan diri dari Farhan kerana telah diberi amaran oleh Mak Timah.(n)

programme.title: Losmen Melati EP5
programme.desc: Melati mendedahkan niat sebenar dia yang ingin mengembalikan anaknya dari kematian. Dengan bantuan seorang Bomoh, Watih, Melati akan membawa pulang anaknya menggunakan darah yang dicuri daripada tetamu mudanya yang telah meninggal dunia sebelum ini. Namun, bukan anaknya sahaja yang ingin dibawa pulang. Melati telah membuat keputusan untuk membawa kembali Sigit - lelaki yang dibesarkannya, seorang lelaki yang mempunyai masa lalu yang kelam dan tragis - Melati percaya bahawa di sebalik kengerian masa lalunya, dia layak mendapat peluang kedua. Makhluk jahat yang pernah terperangkap di ruang bawah tanah didedahkan di Kusno, makhluk jahat dan jahat serta bapa Sigit. Apabila Kusno mula membunuh, dia mula menjadi lebih kuat dan mula menyerupai bentuk manusianya sekali lagi. Kusno mempunyai satu misi - untuk memusnahkan Melati. Tetapi Kusno tidak bersendirian. Dengan menggunakan kuasanya yang semakin meningkat, dia memihak kepada bentuk jahat lelaki yang membunuh ibu Melati pada tahun 1900-an - Pemburu.(n)

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Kini Jamil berada di zaman moden, Jamil pelik melihat apa yang ada didepannya. Dia memandang sekeliling dan melihat bangunan yang tinggi berada di merata-rata dan Jamil menjadi takut apabila dia melihat jalanraya yang sesak dengan kereta. Jamil jadi makin pelik dengan dunia moden ini, orang sekeliling memandangnya serong, mana tidaknya dengan pakaian zaman 60 an, segalanya sangat berbeza dengan zaman moden. Bermulalah kehidupan Jamil di zaman serba canggih yang jauh dari kehidupannya di kampung. Berbekalkan sifat semula jadinya yang lurus bendul, Jamil mahu hidup di zaman moden ini.

programme.title: Rumah Bertangga Lumut

programme.desc: Reflection rancangan yang menyentuh amalan kehidupan seseorang muslim untuk dijadikan teladan dan panduan dalam mengejar redha Allah.(n)

programme.title: My Qurantime 2.0
programme.desc: Rancangan mentadabbur ayat suci Al-Quran dengan misi membawa masyarakat mendalami maksud dan pengajaran darinya setiap hari.(n)

programme.title: Cinta Ilmu

programme.desc: Program yang bertujuan untuk membawa masyarakat lebih dekat dengan Al-Quran, dengan memudahkan mereka untuk mentadabur dan memahami intipati kitab suci.(n)

programme.title: Hadis @114
programme.desc: Hadis 114 menampilkan Dr. Mohd Murshidi Mohd Noor menyampaikan pengajian ilmu "Pembelajaran Asas Hadis-Asah Al-Asanid:Sanad -sanad hadis yang paling sahih" iaitu tentang pembelajaran atau perbincangan mengenai sanad hadis yang palih sahih.(n)

programme.title: Assalamualaikum Subuh (L)
programme.desc: Program bual bicara keagamaan mengupas topik berkaitan dengan menghidupkan ibadah di waktu Subuh bagi meraih keberkatan dari Allah SWT.(n)

programme.title: Assalamualaikum(L)
programme.desc: Sebuah program bual bicara yang membicarakan topik-topik terkini dan menampilkan tetamu-tetamu undangan dari pelbagai bidang secara santai dan bersahaja.(n)

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Main Wayang
programme.desc: Program temu bual santai bersama peminat dan penggiat filem tempatan yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi tetamu berkaitan filem Gemerlapan.

programme.title: One,Two,Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuahprogram yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Dharma Harun yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan filem-filem yang diterajuinya.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran “Hantu-Hantu Dunia” untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Main Wayang
programme.desc: Program temu bual santai bersama peminat dan penggiat filem tempatan yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi tetamu berkaitan filem Gemerlapan.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Dharma Harun yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan filem-filem yang diterajuinya.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan “cool” di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.(n)

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.(n)

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.(n)

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.(n)

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?(n)

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan “cool” di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.(n)

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran “Hantu-Hantu Dunia” untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.(n)

programme.desc: 'KEDIAMAN AGRO' merupakan program dokumentari yang menumpukan kepada teknologi penanaman makanan berskala kecil seperti di kawasan rumah, mahupun mini kebun.(n)

programme.title: Kek & Pastri
programme.desc: Kek & Pastri Siri 2 menampilkan selebriti mencipta resepi kek, pastri, dan hidangan savouri menggunakan bahan tempatan dan teknik membakar serta mengukus untuk hasil yang lazat dan inovatif.(n)

programme.title: River Tales of Borneo
programme.desc: Sarawakian show that tells forgotten stories and folktales from historical times, starting from the mouth of Rejang to Iran Mountain, focusing on ethnic groups living along the rivers.(n)

programme.title: Borneo's Unique Building
programme.desc: Siri dokumentari yang memfokuskan kepada senibina bangunan dan infrastruktur di Sarawak, yang menampilkan dua binaan iaitu satu senibina moden/kontemporari dan satu lagi senibina tradisi/kolonial.(n)

programme.title: Joran Borneo
programme.desc: Masih mengekalkan konsep 'Majalah' travelog, JORAN BORNEO 2 akan meneruskan ekspedisinya bagi menjejaki lubuk ikan-ikan idaman pemancing di pendalaman dan di hulu BORNEO yang bersempadan Kalimantan.(n)

programme.title: Behind the Blood, Sweat & Tears
programme.desc: Behind the scenes with the unsung heroes who tackle these tough roles, exploring the motivations, risks and rewards that come with doing some of the most overlooked professions in the world.(n)

programme.title: My Health, My Choice
programme.desc: My Health, My Choice explores daily practices, behaviors, and health issues, highlighting factors like attitudes, diet, environment, and relationships, and provides practical solutions.(n)

programme.title: (L) TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.(n)

programme.title: Adnan Sempit Generasi Gig
programme.desc: Selepas menyelamatkan Nadia (Afifah Nasir), seorang wanita moden yang telah lama diminatinya, Adnan (Aiman Tino), seorang penghantar makanan, mula jatuh cinta tanpa menyedari bahawa dia mungkin terperangkap dalam rancangan tersembunyi wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Kau Langit Aku Laut
programme.desc: Kau Langit Aku Laut mengisahkan pasangan kekasih yang mempunyai banyak perbezaan dan sering bergaduh. Mereka cuba pertahankan hubungan walaupun banyak cabaran dan salah faham.

programme.title: By My Side
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Faye dan Ben membesar bersama di Subang Jaya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta serta menjalinkan hubungan. Namun hubungan mereka diuji apabila Ben merancang untuk ke Australia, memaksa Faye belajar menghadapi cinta jarak jauh dan kehidupan tanpa dia.

programme.title: La Tahzan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.

programme.title: Hello Goodbye
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.

programme.title: 29 Februari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan.

programme.title: Me VS Mami
programme.desc: Mira terpaksa menemani ibunya, Maudy, dalam satu perjalanan jauh untuk menziarahi neneknya yang sedang tenat. Sepanjang perjalanan, hubungan mereka yang sering dipenuhi pertengkaran diuji melalui pelbagai cabaran dan pertemuan baharu, sehingga mereka akhirnya saling memahami dan mengeratkan hubungan sebagai ibu dan anak.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan.

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminah—ayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Father & Son
programme.desc: Iman, seorang remaja, menjaga bapanya yang sakit. Selepas bapanya meninggal dunia, roh bapanya kembali untuk membantunya menghadapi sekolah, masalah buli, dan kehidupan cinta.

programme.title: Srimulat Hidup Memang Komedi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan awal kumpulan komedi legenda Indonesia, Srimulat, yang berhijrah dari Solo ke Jakarta untuk mengejar impian mencipta nama. Dalam usaha mencapai kejayaan, mereka berdepan pelbagai cabaran, pengorbanan dan konflik, namun terus menghiburkan penonton dengan jenaka dan semangat yang tidak pernah luntur.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: 99 Nama Cinta
programme.desc: Kisah seorang penulis gosip terkenal yang bertemu lelaki berprinsip agama, lalu pertemuan itu mengubah cara hidup, pemikiran dan makna cinta dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Ruang Temu

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.(n)

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Cinta Buta Yang Membawa Petaka
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bernama Anggi yang terjebak dalam hubungan yang toksik dengan seorang lelaki bernama Hendrik. Oleh kerana cinta but, Anggi mengabaikan nasihat daripada keluarga dan rakan-rakannya dan akhirnya membawa penderitaan dan petaka dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta

programme.title: Grow Grow Grow With You
programme.desc: From "Hopscotch" to "Hands Up," TVB's children's programs have accompanied children's growth, creating countless wonderful childhood memories. Veteran children's program hosts Tam Yuk-ying, Lai Chi-shan, and Gai Sai-bo have also grown up alongside you! Each episode will feature a different theme, inviting hosts from different eras to reunite and reminisce about the past. Decades have passed, and the young hosts and participants of yesteryear have all grown up considerably. The hosts have gone out of their way to find these people and relive those memorable moments with everyone. The classic segment "Soaring Through the Air" holds countless happy memories. The hosts and guest Ali Lee will guide a new generation of children through the fun.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing (Sammy) has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan (Priscilla Wong), causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai (KK Cheung), Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei (Zoie Tam). Gold digger Tong Mei-fun (Kamen Kong) is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai (Daniel Chau) and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngai's real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers' understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Miss Hong Kong Pageant 2026
programme.desc: Miss Hong Kong Pageant 2026: Hunan Moments follows the top 12 contestants as they travel to Hengyang, Hunan for intensive training and outdoor filming.

programme.title: Eighth Happiness
programme.desc: The three Fang brothers' love stories begin with a chance phone malfunction. The eldest brother, Fang Jianhui, meets Wu Fenfang during a visit, but their relationship ends when Wu's ex-husband reconciles. The younger brother, Fang Jianlang, though ultimately in love with Tian Hong, continues his philandering ways, later becoming entangled in a love triangle with the beautiful BEAUTY, but ultimately returns to Hong's side. The youngest brother, Fang Jiansheng, meets Yingying, a naive and lively girl, and their romance is warm and sweet.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster" is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to "pass the level" can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT$100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: "'You Are Not Alone' triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the 'King of Ghosts' Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of 'Spirit Connection,' with the team closely following live broadcasts,.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.(n)

programme.title: Cantopop At 50

In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.(n)

Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?(n)

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "News Perspective" is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.(n)

programme.title: Health Commitment Letter
programme.desc: "Health Commitment Letter" is a health-focused information program / public awareness initiative on TVB Jade. It brings in medical professionals and hosts to educate the public on disease prevention, healthy living habits, and wellness management, encouraging viewers to pledge toward a healthier lifestyle.(n)

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster" is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to "pass the level" can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT$100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.(n)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.(n)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.(n)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.(n)

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.(n)

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4" has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating "masked," igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4.".(n)

programme.title: Dear Leslie 70
programme.desc: Dear Leslie 70 is a TVB Jade memorial music special honoring the 70th birth anniversary of Hong Kong legend Leslie Cheung. The show celebrates his legacy across Cantopop, TV, and cinema by showcasing iconic archival performances, classic hits like "Monica" and "Chase," and tribute covers by fellow artists. It also features personal stories and memories shared by close friends, including Leo Ku performing the tribute song "Dear Leslie.".(n)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?(n)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.(n)

programme.title: Her Railway Trip & What's On Today
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.(n)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!(n)

Leaving the capital to inspect the southern Jiangnan region, he is drawn into a series of five strange, seemingly supernatural cases.(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".(n)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals….(n)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!(n)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?(n)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.(n)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?(n)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals….(n)

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers' understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.(n)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!(n)

Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!(n)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.(n)

programme.title: Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.(n)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.(n)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?(n)

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers' understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.(n)

It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.(n)
